protocol.old_study: PR23 INCONCLUSIVE: not a rejection of the complete Bitman methodology
protocol.context: Closed1D SMA200 and confirmed AO divergence2L/2R, diagnostic only
protocol.math: Unmodified PR23 public KONKORDE_PROXY, ADX14/DI14, AO5/34, BBWP CLOSE/SMA7/prior100
protocol.oscillator_anchor: ZERO_CROSS: priorAO<=0 andAO>0 LONG, >=0 and<0 SHORT; STATE_RESUME: same AO sign, slope<=0 to>0 LONG or >=0 to<0 SHORT. No repeated rising-bar anchors.
protocol.sequence: After anchor, first ADX slope<=0 to>0 at age0..6TFbars; then DI may align while ADX still rising within the same window. At trigger AO must retain sign and improving slope. Consume each anchor at first AO/ADX/DI qualification, BEFORE volatility/K gates. No future oscillator/divergence/pivot knowledge.

families.C1: C0 + BBWP>=50 (publicly mentioned reference, mapped to our BBWP proxy, not verified proprietary volatility parity)
families.C2: C0 + LONG positive mountain/inside; SHORT recentEXIT<=lag, outside and mountain falling
families.C3: C0 + LONG recentENTRY<=lag and positive/inside; SHORT EXIT on the same closed bar, no sign-inverted inside geometry
families.C4: LONG ONLY C0 + inside positive mountain and separation increasing across consecutive inside bars
families.C5: LONG ONLY C0 + recent quickREENTRY<=lag, prior EXIT age<=3TFbars, inside positive mountain

protocol.unavailable_short: C4/C5 have NO SHORT analogue: outside separation/reentry geometry does not justify mirroring
protocol.reentry: 3bars primary is an explicit research implementation, not an exact public constant;2/5 neighbors diagnostic only
protocol.near_zero: Unchanged PR23 TRAIN tercile boundaries, descriptive only, never a gate
protocol.event_selection: Physically trim data to end2023 before features. EachTF/side independently: TRAIN andVALIDATION >=30 matched24h events, positive directional mean AND positive matched-control excess both. Select highest min(TRAIN,VALIDATION) matched excess, then higher minimum n, then family name. If none eligible, deterministic diagnostic fallback, never promotable. No TEST selection.
protocol.controls: Match non-candidate-event times by UTCyear/month/hour, trailing24TF trend sign, no future returns; exclude union of all registered candidate events. No return-based resampling.
protocol.stages: Freeze protocol -> DEV event study -> freeze4selected parents -> DEV strategy check -> freeze eligibility -> TEST events and only frozen selected strategies/diagnostic ablations/controls
protocol.strategy_development_gate: Selected parent only: >=20 net trades and positive expectancy in TRAIN andVALIDATION. Failure marks nonpromotable; do not rerank to another family after strategy results.
protocol.execution: Academic1x nominal at entry fixedqty. Signal closedTF, nextTF open (sameboundary next1H open). No pyramiding, no samebar reverse; LONG andSHORT independent; never add their1x curves.
protocol.primary_exit: Initial2ATR14 of signalTF frozen at signal; opposite confirmedAO sign exits nextopen; max168h. Stops checked on public1H data, conservative stop/gap precedence, no TP optimization.
protocol.alternate_exit: Selected-only diagnostic initial2ATR plus3ATR trailing of frozen ATR, updated after1Hclose for nextbar; oppositeAO and168h cap retained. Not selected or used to rescue primary.
protocol.funding: Verified historical signed settlement on remaining fixedqty; current1Hopen price proxy; charge pre-order holdings at settlement boundary. Not exact Bitunix margin/liquidation modeling.
protocol.robustness: Frozen selected parents: lag3/9 neighbors, reentry2/5 if used, BBWP40/60 if50used (diagnostic, NEVER selection). Deduplicate identical signal masks before stability count. 2ATRstop1.6/2.4 neighbors; removebest1/3; weekly bootstrap500 seed6241; yearly/regime/volatility cohorts.
protocol.ablation: RemoveAO: ADXturn/DI events with no AO anchor/sign dependence; removeADX_DI: AO anchors only, no ADXturn nor DI gate; removeBBWP removes rising AND50; removeK removes that family geometry only (absent=no-op, not independent evidence). All share identical exits unless nativeK comparator explicitly labeled.
protocol.comparisons: K_ENTRY common exit and nativeENTRY/EXIT LONG only; AOADXstate baseline; EMA10/55 LONG/SHORT baseline; exact V8 lastclosed4H close>SMA200 LONG/FLAT; event comparisons same horizons/matching. No unsupported K-only SHORT strategy.
protocol.walk_forward: Annual2022..2026: anchored TRAIN2020..year-2, VALIDATION year-1, selectevents only beforeyear; strategy DEV eligibility then evaluateyear. GlobalTEST selection never changes. EarlierTEST years may become past fold data.
protocol.regimes: Bull/bear uses lastclosed4H close/SMA200; rangeADX<20 diagnostic only; volatility cutpoint TRAIN median signalTF ATR/close. Closed1D context unavailable until warmup, not defaultbear.

promotion.comparable_advantage: Higher totalreturn vs AOADX baseline OR lowerDD with positive netreturn; K-family additionally needs positive matched24h increment over noK on TRAIN/VALIDATION

protocol.classification: PROMISING FOR SHADOW only if all gates for an independently evaluated side/TF; REJECT when all four frozen primary strategies have nonpositiveTESTexpectancy; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. No live classification, no private-methodology rejection.
protocol.evidence_grade: A requires independent forward evidence (unavailable); B only PROMISING FOR SHADOW; C otherwise. Grades are evidence labels, not probabilities or sizing.
protocol.rsi: PRIVATE / PARITY NOT PROVEN, excluded; production ML RSI unchanged
protocol.forward_volume_data: PENDING / NOT ACCESSIBLE FROM CURRENT CONNECTOR
